findings.finding: YC memory reference found, but no complete pixel-buffer/DMA descriptor resolved
findings.missing: Concrete runtime source MemoryHandle at producer input+10/+d4; backing DMM allocation/mapping and meaning of block pairs; original width/height/pitch/format field semantics. No proved pixel-plane address or DMA completion/ownership/cache contract.
findings.scope: No direct CPU pixel write or DMA-done condition identified in the requested decompiled chain. This is not proof that downstream drivers or unresolved virtual calls never access image memory.

findings.finding: PIN message route is identified, final image consumer is runtime-dependent
findings.evidence: 435a9928 builds a 34-byte message record; 435aa20c allocates/copies/sends message bytes. 4379744c handles 50004 control messages and 435a9b30 configures peer tuple/state. It is not demonstrated to receive the YC pixel payload itself.
findings.missing: Runtime peer tuple in each output pin object +8/+c/+10/+14 and DMM source allocation; no invented fixed consumer edge.

findings.finding: Physical exposure end, image DMA completion and fully electronic silent capture
findings.evidence: No camera connected, no firmware execution or flashing; static logs and names do not prove physical behavior.

evidence_limitations: Function names and signatures are decompiler inferences, not original Sony symbols; calls can preserve r1 even when a displayed prototype omits it.
PIC literal/code region 43541000..43bc0000 is treated as constant only in the temporary analysis view; data RAM remains writable; bytes never changed.
Exploratory queries 43796522, 435498ca and 43549d42 are interior fragments, superseded by full 43796518 and 43549380 exports; do not treat fragments as function entries.
4379cdb0 is a literal-pool query with no function; its failed exploratory decompilation is recorded, not hidden.
Generic virtual dispatch and owner-release callback at payload+18 -> vtable+c remain runtime-dependent; no targets invented.
